The following versions of Johnson Controls CEM AC2000 are affected: CEM AC2000 12.0 (CVE(s)) CEM AC2000 11.0 (CVE(s)) CEM AC2000 10.6 (CVE(s)) CVSS Vendor Equipment Vulnerabilities v3 8.7 Johnson Controls Inc.
